description_en: Deletes specified text chunks from a knowledge base. Deleted text chunks cannot be retrieved or recalled
description_zh: 删除知识库中的指定文本切片，被删的文本切片将无法被检索和召回
name: DeleteChunk

parameters.description_en: The knowledge base ID, which is the `Data.Id` returned by the **CreateIndex** operation.
parameters.description_zh: 知识库 ID，即 **CreateIndex** 接口返回的`Data.Id`。
parameters.help_en: The knowledge base ID, which is the `Data.Id` returned by the **CreateIndex** operation
parameters.help_zh: 知识库 ID，即 **CreateIndex** 接口返回的`Data.Id`
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.description_en: The workspace ID of the knowledge base. To obtain the workspace ID, refer to [How to use a workspace](~~2587495~~).
parameters.description_zh: 知识库所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见[如何使用业务空间](~~2587495~~)。
parameters.help_en: The workspace ID of the knowledge base. To obtain the workspace ID, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description_en: The list of text chunks to delete. A maximum of 10 text chunk IDs can be specified in a single request.
parameters.description_zh: 需要删除的文本切片列表（单次最多传入10个文本切片ID）。
parameters.help_en: The list of text chunks to delete. A maximum of 10 text chunk IDs can be specified in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的文本切片列表（单次最多传入10个文本切片ID）
parameters.name: chunk_ids
